questions.prompt: Daudi is a pupil. ___ is in class three. (A She, B They, C He, D We)
steps: The intended male name Daudi takes he.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: We use ___ for writing. (A pen, B spoon, C bag, D razor blade)
steps: A pen is a writing tool.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: They ___ playing. (A is, B are, C has, D was)
steps: They is plural and takes are.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: She ___ swimming. (A is, B has, C are, D have)
steps: She is singular and takes is.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Which is a domestic animal? (A elephant, B antelope, C lion, D cow)
steps: Cows are commonly kept as livestock.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Our mother told ___ to stay here. (A I, B we, C us, D he)
steps: The verb told requires an object pronoun, us.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: They are ___ football now. (A plays, B play, C playing, D played)
steps: Are plus playing is present continuous.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: We sleep at ___. (A morning, B night, C noon, D tomorrow)
steps: At night is the correct phrase and intended usual sleeping time.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: ___ are you late? (A Why, B What, C Where, D With)
steps: Why asks for the reason for being late.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The plural of book is ___. (A box, B boxes, C book, D books)
steps: Add s to the regular noun.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Rehema is my best friend. ___ loves cooking.
steps: She refers to Rehema and agrees with loves.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Peter is going to the birthday party. ___ is going with Baraka.
steps: He refers to Peter.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Elice and Lina are good dancers. ___ are intelligent girls too.
steps: They refers to both girls.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Look at the cow under the tree. ___ is big and fat.
steps: It refers to the cow.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Japheti and I went to the zoo. ___ saw lions, giraffes and zebras.
steps: A group including the speaker takes we.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The school bag is ___ the table.
steps: The picture places the bag on the tabletop.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The cat is ___ the box.
steps: The cat is inside the open box.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The cat is ___ the box (printed; picture shows a chair).
steps: The picture shows a ball beneath a chair. Both cat and box in the printed sentence disagree with the illustration.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: Under the chair (pictured ball); under is the intended preposition.

questions.prompt: My parents ___ many hens. (have, has)
steps: Parents is plural and takes have.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Joyce ___ two pens. (have, has)
steps: Joyce is singular and takes has.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: He ___ the best car. (have, has)
steps: He takes has.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: We ___ many oranges. (have, has)
steps: We takes have.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Who woke up late?
steps: The opening sentence names him.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Why did Musa miss the bus?
steps: The first sentence links his late waking with the missed bus.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: How did he feel on arrival?
steps: The passage says he arrived tired.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Did he miss the test?
steps: The final clause says he did not miss the test.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: How did Musa walk to school?
steps: He decided to walk quickly after missing the bus.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
